text:
marie: Hey @front-desk — my friend is popping by at 2pm with a tiny dog (very well-behaved) and a potted fern. Can we have a visitor badge ready and a temporary spot by the east window with an outlet? Also there might be a small package for me today — can you hold it if it arrives? :smile:
front-desk: Yep — badge ready. Quick notes: pups ok in the lounge only (please leash), east window has one shared outlet, and we can hold packages in locker B2. What name should we put on the badge?
marie: Name: "Elliot Park". If the package arrives for "Marie Chen" please ring x1023. We'll bring a small mat for the floor so the dog isn't on the chair.
reception-bot: Badge print queued for guest "Elliot Park" at 13:58 — Badge ID G-1945.
tony: FYI if they want a quieter corner we can free up the focus nook couch on 2nd floor — I'm out by 3pm if that helps.
alia: Heads-up: if the plant is large please don't put it on the mail shelf (it's fragile). @front-desk can you stick a 'Fragile' note on the package if it arrives?
front-desk: Will do. Also note: a UPS package for Marie arrived early — labelled "fragile ceramics" and there's a faint coffee smell? Storing in locker B2 and will ring when they arrive.
ben: :dog: Can I bring my pupper too? (kidding) Enjoy the fern!
marie: haha yes bring pupper later :thumbsup:
front-desk: Visitor checked in at 14:03. Badge printed and handed to Elliot. Package signed and placed in B2. Sticky note "Fragile - do not place on mail shelf" attached. Called x1023.
marie: You're the best, thanks everyone! Can someone save the armchair by the east window for us? The plant likes the light.
tony: I'll move the armchair over in 2 mins.
front-desk: Chair moved, mat placed, plug extension available. All set for arrival.
marie: Perfect—see you in a bit!
